registryEntry.label: Windows 10/11 Device Compliance Policy (CMMC baseline)
registryEntry.get_command: (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceCompliancePolicies?$expand=assignments').value | Where-Object { ($_.displayName -eq 'CMMC-Compliance-Windows') -or ((@('#microsoft.graph.windows10CompliancePolicy') -contains $_.'@odata.type') -and ($_.passwordRequired -eq $true) -and ($null -ne $_.passwordMinimumLength -and [double]$_.passwordMinimumLength -ge 14) -and ($null -ne $_.passwordPreviousPasswordBlockCount -and [double]$_.passwordPreviousPasswordBlockCount -ge 24) -and ($null -ne $_.passwordMinutesOfInactivityBeforeLock -and [double]$_.passwordMinutesOfInactivityBeforeLock -ge 1) -and ($null -ne $_.passwordMinutesOfInactivityBeforeLock -and [double]$_.passwordMinutesOfInactivityBeforeLock -le 15) -and ($_.bitLockerEnabled -eq $true) -and ($_.secureBootEnabled -eq $true) -and ($_.codeIntegrityEnabled -eq $true) -and ($_.defenderEnabled -eq $true) -and ($_.rtpEnabled -eq $true) -and (@($_.osMinimumVersion | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -gt 0) -and (@($_.assignments | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -gt 0)) } | Sort-Object { $_.displayName -ne 'CMMC-Compliance-Windows' } | Select-Object -First 1 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
registryEntry.set_command: $created = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceCompliancePolicies' -Body (@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.windows10CompliancePolicy';displayName='CMMC-Compliance-Windows';description='CMMC L2 Windows 10/11 device compliance baseline';passwordRequired=$true;passwordBlockSimple=$true;passwordRequiredType='alphanumeric';passwordMinimumLength=14;passwordPreviousPasswordBlockCount=24;passwordMinutesOfInactivityBeforeLock=15;bitLockerEnabled=$true;secureBootEnabled=$true;codeIntegrityEnabled=$true;storageRequireEncryption=$true;defenderEnabled=$true;rtpEnabled=$true;antivirusRequired=$true;antiSpywareRequired=$true;osMinimumVersion='10.0.19045';scheduledActionsForRule=@(@{ruleName='PasswordRequired';scheduledActionConfigurations=@(@{actionType='block';gracePeriodHours=0;notificationTemplateId='';notificationMessageCCList=@()})})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) -ContentType 'application/json'; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceCompliancePolicies/$($created.id)/assign" -Body (@{assignments=@(@{target=@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.groupAssignmentTarget';groupId='{cuiGroupId}'}})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) -ContentType 'application/json' | Out-Null; $created | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
